_comment: Template for onboarding a new PRAPS2 country. Copy this file, rename to the ISO3 code (e.g. mli.json for Mali), and fill in every field marked TODO. No code changes are needed in praps2_engine.py - it reads whichever config it's pointed at.
ndvi_csv: TODO - path or URL to the HDX 'NDVI at Subnational Level' CSV for this country (dataset slug pattern: <iso3-lower>-ndvi-subnational)
rainfall_csv: TODO - path or URL to the HDX 'Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level' CSV (dataset slug pattern: <iso3-lower>-rainfall-subnational)
season_start: TODO - e.g. 2026-06-01, the start of this country's rainy season

pcode_to_name_adm1._comment: Map each admin1 P-code used in the NDVI/rainfall CSVs to a readable region name. Get this from the country's HDX cod-ab-<iso3> gazetteer.

pcode_prefix_to_wilaya._comment: Same mapping, used to assign admin2 (moughataa/cercle/departement - naming varies by country) units to their parent admin1 region.

area_km2_by_wilaya._comment: From the country's national statistics agency or the ANSADE-equivalent COD-AB admin1 layer (area_sqkm field).

livestock_by_wilaya._comment: From the country's most recent livestock census (Mauritania used RGE 2024). If no recent census exists, this component of PSVI cannot be computed until one is available - flag this rather than estimating.

tlu_weights._comment: Standard Tropical Livestock Unit conversion factors - these are usually the same across Sahel countries, but confirm against the national census methodology.
